notes: New: Scans your real PC when Windows system access is on. The example PC is only used in previews.
New: The speed score, boot time and memory use now come from your own computer.
New: Fixes apply for real. A restore point is made first, and Windows asks for permission if it needs to.
New: Undo any change one by one, or undo everything, from the Results screen.
New: Close running programs from the Running now screen.
New: Windows tools buttons now open the real Windows control panels, including System Restore.
New: The Processor activity graph shows your PC's live readings.
Improved: Results show real before and after numbers, and tell you when to restart and scan again.
